ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1817492085000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.
